name: gameplan
description: Runs a life-sciences communications firm's client work inside Claude: know the field, watch the news, pitch the right reporters, and measure what landed.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Start here. Say "set us up", then "set up" and your client's name: Gameplan sets the client up across every plugin on one go-ahead and keeps a page of where things stand. Each morning, ask what's due.

plugins.name: competitive-intel
plugins.description: Know the field: competitors, the dates that will make news, and what to say either way, as a Word landscape. Runs as part of "set up" and your client's name; afterwards, ask what's coming up for your client, or what do we say if something happens. Needs core.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: Your client's news every morning, explained and ready to send as a Word file, plus coverage reports. Set up as part of "set up" and your client's name; then ask what's due each morning. Needs core.

plugins.name: media-targeting
plugins.description: Pitch the right reporters. Your client's media list is built during setup; when you have news, say "pitch this for" your client and paste the release. Two weeks later, see what it landed. Needs core.

plugins.name: narrative-pulse
plugins.description: What AI engines say about your client: what's missing, what's wrong, and where to fix it. Runs as part of "set up" and your client's name; after that, Gameplan suggests when to check again. Needs core.
